description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the KpiService in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It verifies behaviors such as retrieving the DAO, saving KPIs, handling defaults, and exception scenarios.

classes.name: KpiServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the KpiService in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the KpiService instance and populates test data fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetKpiDao
methods.description: Verifies that getKpiDao returns an instance of KpiDao.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI entity via the KpiService.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue
methods.description: Tests saving a KPI marked as default and verifies it replaces existing default KPIs.

methods.name: testSaveKpiWithDefaultTrue2
methods.description: Tests the behavior when setting a new default KPI, ensuring the previous default is unset.

methods.name: testKpiServiceExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Ensures that saving a KPI with invalid ratings throws a KpiServiceException.

methods.name: testTransactionExceptionForSaveKpi
methods.description: Checks that a TransactionException is thrown if DAO retrieval fails during KPI save.
